title: FoFlatAllDimensions
description: Adds a Flat All Dimensions world type for Overworld, Nether, and End.
body:
![Flat All Dimensions world type selected](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PWYOd4Kw/images/740d39c02f7629df34029de07dad0e0cbbc60757.png)

FoFlatAllDimensions is a tiny Fabric mod that adds **Flat All Dimensions** to Minecraft's normal world type selector. Pick it when creating a new world to generate flat-style terrain in the Overworld, Nether, and End without adding commands, config screens, items, blocks, or extra gameplay systems.

## Features
- Adds **Flat All Dimensions** to the standard `World Type` button in the Create New World menu.
- Uses Minecraft's vanilla `flat_all_dimensions` world preset entry instead of a code-heavy custom generator.
- Applies flat-style terrain across the Overworld, Nether, and End, not only the Overworld.
- Keeps the mod lightweight with no commands, config files, items, blocks, or custom GUI screens.
- Useful for testing, building, mapmaking, and clean worlds where every vanilla dimension should be flat.

![Flat Overworld generation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PWYOd4Kw/images/e75936ef4c717caebcb9bd01ca6b3d613ffbd602.png)

## Flat Dimensions
The preset keeps every vanilla dimension simple to inspect, build in, and test against.

![Flat Nether generation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PWYOd4Kw/images/9f728fbece860d91172ad239906709fa2ece3044.png)

![Flat End generation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/PWYOd4Kw/images/c8ba3718f0afe95b1f35402aadb272399bc3e744.png)

## Usage
1. Install the mod with Fabric.
2. Create a new world.
3. Cycle the `World Type` button until **Flat All Dimensions** appears.
4. Create the world and use the normal vanilla world creation options.
